title: CondMSP: Condition-Informed and Resource-Aware Inorganic Materials Synthesis Planning
abstract: arXiv:2610.15603v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Materials synthesis planning (MSP) connects AI-driven materials discovery to experimental realization by proposing precursors, synthesis operations, and processing conditions for a target material. Existing approaches predict these components separately or in pairs and treat conditions only as a prediction target. Consequently, MSP remains centered on recipe prediction: it leaves unexplored how conditions can serve as process context for constructing synthesis routes, and it does not address which candidate routes should be executed under limited experimental resources. We propose CondMSP, which extends MSP from recipe prediction to execution-aware planning. translated_title: CondMSP：条件感知与资源感知的无机材料合成规划
translated_abstract: 材料合成规划（MSP）通过为目标材料提出前驱体、合成操作和处理条件，将AI驱动的材料发现与实验实现连接起来。现有方法分别或成对地预测这些组成部分，并且仅将条件视为预测目标。因此，MSP仍然以配方预测为中心：它尚未探索条件如何作为构建合成路线的过程上下文，也没有解决在有限实验资源下应执行哪些候选路线的问题。我们提出了CondMSP，将MSP从配方预测扩展到面向执行的规划。CondMSP通过结合联合预测器与针对特定变量的专家模型来预测温度、时间和气氛，然后将这些预测既用作过程上下文，为操作序列的生成和检索提供依据，又用作执行要求，指定在有限的实验资源下哪些候选路线应当被实际执行。
tldr: 提出CondMSP框架，将材料合成规划从单纯的配方预测扩展为面向执行的规划：通过联合预测器与变量专家模型预测温度、时间和气氛等条件，并将这些条件同时用作生成与检索合成路线的过程上下文，以及在有限实验资源下筛选应执行候选路线的执行依据。
en_tdlr: CondMSP extends materials synthesis planning from recipe prediction to execution-aware planning by jointly predicting temperature, time, and atmosphere with a hybrid of a joint predictor and variable-specific experts, and leveraging these conditions both as process context for grounding synthesis route generation and retrieval, and as execution requirements for selecting which candidate routes to run under limited experimental resources.
